notes: «أن إبراهيم بن عبد الله الجعفري حدثه» is a link by rule 5; «عن عدة من أهل بيته» is an unnamed transmitter (rule 8).
The last link is Musa b. Ja'far, whose will the matn gives. He is written after «عن» inside the chain, so he stays narrator (owner ruling 2).
«قالَ عَبْدِ اللَّه بْنِ مُحَمَّد الجَعْفَرِيُّ» opens a story inside the report about the will's terms, not a second route; left out.
